title: Chapter 135 Teaching
content:
Chapter 135 Teaching

Everyone was exposed to this kind of knowledge for the first time, and they were a little unsure in their hearts.

"Forget it, forget it, practice makes perfect, go prepare the materials first, and let's practice!"

But at this time, Wang Shuo looked a little embarrassed.

Although Wang Shuo killed a large number of bosses, there was no bronze boss of the wolf type.

The most suitable silver-level white wolf boss was swallowed directly by the toad.

"Is tiger hair okay?" Wang Shuo asked with some concern.

"Just make do!" Xiao Laoteng said reluctantly, looking at Wang Shuo's territory, which looked dilapidated, and he didn't have any expectations.

After a while, the required materials were ready.

At first glance, it turned out to be the tiger hair of the silver boss, and he couldn't help but look up to Wang Shuo.

Xiao Laoteng started from making talisman pens and taught everyone step by step.

Seeing Wang Shuo mixed in and making talisman pens, Xiao Laoteng showed a strange look. He had never seen which lord would make things like city wall bricks.

Could it be that the other party was in a momentary mood?

Yes, that must be the case.

So, he stopped paying attention to Wang Shuo.

Other masons in the territory cherished this opportunity very much, especially those who had not yet been able to comprehend the making of city wall bricks, and they worked very hard.

...

It must be said that Xiao Laoteng was still very good at teaching students.

After another 3 hours, the first person finally learned it.

This person was Yan Fujie. Seeing a hexagonal pattern on a brick in front of him, the light was endless.

Xiao Jingteng smiled with relief.

He seemed to see that 10,000 energy crystals were about to be obtained.

This trip was a big profit!

He was ecstatic in his heart, but his face did not show it.

Not long after, Wang Shuo also successfully drew the defense rune.

Xiao Laoteng looked at Wang Shuo, and was a little shocked. He was surprised and said in his heart: "This lord actually has this talent."

Wang Shuo also smiled.

Since he had already mastered this technology, Wang Shuo thought that he might as well let Xiao Laoteng demonstrate in full how to make city bricks, so that the masons in the territory could avoid some detours.

Now time is tight, and they are equivalent to conducting technical research.

There is a ready-made master, so why not use it?

Under Wang Shuo's soft and hard persuasion.

Wang Shuo added another 1,000 energy crystals before the other party agreed.

At the kiln factory, Xiao Laoteng began to talk about how to select materials, how to mix mud, and the proportions of various materials such as iron powder, clay, and water...

Wang Shuo was overwhelmed by the countless knowledge and skills that flooded into his mind, like a revelation.

It is true that listening to your words is better than reading for ten years!

Many things that I understood before suddenly became clear.

[Your "mixing mud" skill has been upgraded to level 4. ]

Unexpectedly, the skill he first acquired was upgraded.

Wang Shuo was overjoyed and wanted to practice it immediately.

"Okay, next, you guys try it." Xiao Laoteng said, and asked everyone to start practicing.

Wang Shuo felt that this architect could make black iron bricks by himself without even the assistance of the system.

After another 2 hours, everyone's skill level had improved to varying degrees.

Especially Yan Fujie, his "mud-smoothing" skill actually went directly from level 2 to level 4.

Wang Shuo had to marvel at his talent.

"Lord, the process of making bricks will take about 1 day,..."

Before the other party finished speaking, Wang Shuo's heart skipped a beat: "What? It takes so long?"

"Of course, this is black iron bricks!"

By the time this brick is made, it's probably too late.

"Is there any way to get bricks quickly?"

"Yes!" Xiao Laoteng said with a smile.

"What way?" Wang Shuo was a little excited.

There was no way, the bandits' attack was imminent.
